sloka: द्वाःस्थं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा अगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः ।निवेद्यतां दाशरथेर्ऋषीनस्मान्समागतान् ।। ७.१.८ ॥
transliteration: dvāḥsthaṁ provāca dharmātmā agastyo munisattamaḥ ।nivedyatāṁ dāśaratherṛṣīnasmānsamāgatān ।। 7.1.8 ॥

translations.english: The righteous Agastya, the best of sages, spoke to the doorkeeper, instructing him to announce their arrival to Rama, the son of Dasharatha.
